Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 36: the slip of [[Return Of A Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) Obi-Wan's Cape, Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, or Obi-Wan. OR Unless Inner Strength on table, use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting Obi-Wan (or a just drawn duel or lightsaber combat destiny if Obi-Wan is participating).”), word for word the text of [[Return Of A Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
